data.narrative: Outstanding performance on Module 03 risk-first ordering and adaptive execution. Developed a rigorous 4-part risk taxonomy, annotated all 13 work items, front-loaded critical spikes, and responded with exceptional engineering maturity to the non-technical payment blocker by defining a clean IPaymentGateway stub to keep 100% of the team productive.

dimension_scores.observation: Identified that payment processing carries both technical integration risk and unstated external legal/merchant prerequisites.
dimension_scores.evidence: Extracted business entity and merchant account requirements as mandatory prerequisites for live payments in break-risk-diagnosis.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Correctly isolated what was truly blocked by the payment issue versus what could proceed using soft dependency stubs.
dimension_scores.evidence: Maintained DAG integrity by bifurcating WI-07 into WI-07a Interface/Mock Adapter and WI-07b Live Stripe Integration.

dimension_scores.observation: Defined risk concretely using Integration, Novelty, Dependency, Scale, and Business dimensions, accurately separating difficulty from uncertainty.
dimension_scores.evidence: Annotated all 13 items with 1-5 scores and clearly articulated why Auth is low-risk but high-dependency in verify-risk-plan.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Designed an unambiguous, strongly-typed IPaymentGateway interface contract with explicit inputs and outputs.
dimension_scores.evidence: Specified TypeScript interface contracts for processPayment and processRefund in fix-risk-plan.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Immediately pivoted execution sequence when business blocker occurred, drafted a concise two-sentence PM escalation, and re-ordered the backlog.
dimension_scores.evidence: Elevated Booking Mutex (WI-06) and Multi-City Listings (WI-02) while parking live Stripe integration on a gated external queue.

dimension_scores.observation: Engineered a pluggable adapter architecture that isolates downstream booking and cancellation systems from third-party gateway volatility.
dimension_scores.evidence: Demonstrated that MockPaymentGateway enables 100% of checkout, cancellation, and review workflows to be verified without external API keys.

strengths: Demonstrated advanced engineering maturity by distinguishing technical code risk from organizational/business prerequisite blockers.
Applied contract-first stubbing (IPaymentGateway) to prevent an external blocker from stalling team momentum.
data.recommendation: Carry forward this interface-driven decomposition into Module 04 when carving vertical slices through the architecture.

public_evidence.student_action: Formulated a risk-first build plan, evaluated critical unknowns, and adapted architecture around an external business blocker.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Risk-annotated dependency execution plan featuring early spikes, IPaymentGateway contract stubbing, and multi-city schema prioritization.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Proves ability to de-risk engineering projects by retiring critical unknowns early and decoupling team velocity from external vendor/business delays.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Ordered 13 work items by unknown retirement while respecting DAG hard dependencies.
Designed IPaymentGateway contract to decouple booking and refund flows from Stripe merchant account blockers.

teaching_approaches.detail: Integration, Novelty, Dependency, Scale, and Business risk framing.
